recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of three men standing in a desert landscape during golden hour. The composition features a central figure in denim, flanked by two others, set against a hazy, overexposed sky and a scrubby, arid ground. The overall mood is warm, nostalgic, and slightly gritty.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm golden light source originating from behind the right-most figure
Triangular arrangement of figures creating depth and focus
coreInvariants: High-key, blown-out white sky at the top
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects' height
Visible film grain or halftone texture across the image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the middle and foreground, scaled to fill approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the blue denim jacket acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top text, moves down to the central figure, and then follows the horizon line across the other two members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third (sky) and lower foreground (sand).

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and sand tones in the landscape.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool indigo and denim blues in the foreground clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white/yellow flare from the sun behind the subjects.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky, medium saturation in the clothing, and muted earth tones in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones, denim blues, and sun-bleached whites

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Humanist sans-serif with irregular, hand-drawn proportions
letterConstructionRules: Uneven stroke weights with a 'bleeding ink' or 'stamped' effect
Varied baseline and cap height for a rhythmic, organic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' characters have a high crossbar and wide stance
The 'S' has a tight, coiled spine
Lowercase letters for secondary text feature a liquid, melting aesthetic
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, dark, stamped-style header paired with a soft, ethereal, light-colored lowercase sub-header.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the stamped, irregular feel of the main title.
Matches the 'melted' look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of three men in early 2000s casual fashion (denim jackets, leather jackets) standing in a flat desert landscape. The sky is overexposed white. A warm sun flare hits from the right. Apply a slight halftone grain and warm color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, black, hand-drawn distressed font at the top center. Add a secondary word in a smaller, soft blue, liquid-style lowercase font on the left side near the central figure's shoulder.

verificationChecks: Does the main text have a stamped, irregular texture?
Is the color palette dominated by warm desert tones and denim blue?
Is the halftone texture visible across the entire image?

adjustableVariables: Degree of 'melting' distortion on the secondary text
Subject clothing styles (keeping within the denim/leather theme)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through figure placement

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look like a standard system font.
Check that the sun flare doesn't obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the horizon line is straight but soft.
Confirm the halftone effect is subtle and not distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key desert portrait with hand-stamped black display type and a secondary 'liquid' accent word to create a nostalgic early-2000s country-rock aesthetic.
